name: STPI Creative Workshop & Gallery
known: The presses were shipped from his New York studio and a paper mill was installed (Wikipedia, which credits Renaissance City Plan director Liu Thai Ker with persuading him).
Patrons Programme: Individual Patron S$2,500 and Corporate Patron S$5,000, with benefits including studio visits, curator tours, a limited edition print and a signed exhibition catalogue.

name: Singapore Art Museum
known: Dr Eugene Tan has been Director of SAM since 2019 and, since 1 April 2024, Chief Executive Officer of National Gallery Singapore and SAM and Head of the Visual Arts Cluster, which comprises the Gallery, SAM and STPI (National Gallery Singapore media release, 13 March 2024).
Board: Edmund Cheng, Deputy Chairman of Wing Tai Holdings, chairs.
Audrey Tan of the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth and Elaine Ng, CEO of the National Arts Council, sit as ex-officio members (SAM About page).
Board member Pierre Lorinet is a director of oil trader Trafigura (joined 1 Jul 2024).

name: Singapore Art Museum (SAM)
known: Dr Eugene Tan has been Director of SAM since 2019 and, since 1 April 2024, Chief Executive Officer of National Gallery Singapore and SAM and Head of the Visual Arts Cluster, which comprises the Gallery, SAM and STPI (National Gallery Singapore media release, 13 March 2024).
Board: Edmund Cheng, Deputy Chairman of Wing Tai Holdings, chairs.
Audrey Tan of the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth and Elaine Ng, CEO of the National Arts Council, sit as ex-officio members (SAM About page).

name: Tanoto Art Foundation
known: Xiaoyu Weng is artistic director (e-flux).
First exhibition: "Rituals of Perception", 21 January to 1 March 2026 at New Bahru School Hall, curated by Weng, with more than twenty artists.
Its About page names only a curator, a communications manager and an adviser.

name: Kunsthalle Bratislava
known: Founded by the Ministry of Culture and funded as its contributory organisation; the space's page gives no budget figures.
Director Jen Kratochvíl resigned on 15 January 2024.

name: Slovak National Gallery
known: The minister of culture appoints and dismisses the director: Martina Šimkovičová dismissed Alexandra Kusá on 7 August 2024 (The Art Newspaper).
Šimkovičová dismissed director Alexandra Kusá in August 2024 and accused her of a conflict of interest, which Kusá denies.

name: Kapelica Gallery (Kersnikova Institute)
known: Jurij Krpan, an architect and curator, has led the gallery since its founding (culture.gov.si).

Managed by the Kersnikova Institute, a Ljubljana nonprofit founded in 2000 as the K6/4 Institute through a restructuring of the University of Ljubljana's Student Organisation, which remains a founder.
Run by the Kersnikova Institute, founded by the University of Ljubljana's student organisation; a member of EMAP with LABoral, iMAL, Ars Electronica and Onassis.
Its Crew page names a director and staff.

name: MGLC International Centre of Graphic Arts
known: The founding decree (Article 10) says the institute obtains its funds from the founder's budget, payments for services and other sources permitted by law; surpluses from public-service activities can be used only to run and develop those activities (Article 11, Uradni list RS 42/1999).
The founder is liable for the institute's obligations on a limited, subsidiary basis, up to the funds in the founder's budget for the institute's activities (decree, Article 12, title translated).
The founder appoints the director through a public tender for five years (Article 5).

name: Moderna Galerija (MG+MSUM)
known: The Ministry of Culture, as the founder of Moderna galerija, issued the call for applications for the post of director (CIMAM, text of 10 March 2022).

name: Plečnik House
known: MGML is a public institute founded by the City of Ljubljana (MGML site).

name: Solomon Islands National Museum
known: Tony Heorake is the director (Wikipedia;
1974: a museum curator funded by the United Kingdom Assistance Programme (Solomon Islands Historical Encyclopaedia).

name: A4 Arts Foundation
known: It grew out of talks between collector Wendy Fisher and Josh Ginsburg, its first director (Business Day).

name: Norval Foundation
known: Founded by the property investor Louis Norval, who chairs the board of trustees.

The About page names twelve trustees: Louis Norval (Chair), Mareli Vorster, Lizelle Kilbourn, Robyn Merrington, Kami Gahiga, Caroline Greyling, Steve Kettle, Hannah O'Leary, Gary Vogelman, Seth Shezi, Nonkululeko Nyembezi-Heita and Liesl Fichardt.

name: Zeitz MOCAA
known: Wikipedia lists the V&A Waterfront and Jochen Zeitz as founders and Mark Coetzee as founding executive director and chief curator.
Koyo Kouoh was executive director and chief curator from May 2019 until her death in May 2025 (Wikipedia).
The museum's supporters page lists four founders: Growthpoint, Jochen Zeitz, the Public Investment Corporation and the V&A Waterfront.

BMW Group South Africa agreed a three-year naming-rights partnership for 2024 to 2026 that renamed its Centre for Art Education and supports curatorial and education programming (BMW Group press release, 12 September 2024).
Its supporters page names corporate members, founders and sponsors including the Mellon Foundation and BMW, undated.

name: Bag Factory Artists' Studios
known: On site: studios for resident artists, a visiting artist programme (up to eight a year), a visiting curator programme (up to four a year), self-funded residencies from US$500 a month, exhibitions, open studios, a shop and Factory Circle membership.
The organisation says its visiting artist and curator programme is "partially funded, dependent on international partnerships and access to funding".
